topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining its focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation using previously introduced immune concepts.

topics.label: Pathogen Recognition Receptors and Danger Sensing
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system identifies infections and cellular damage through pattern recognition receptors, specific ligand properties, and intracellular signaling complexes like the inflammasome.

topics.label: Sentinel Cell Signaling, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how activated sentinel cells orchestrate leukocyte recruitment and lymphatic trafficking during an immune response and discuss the clinical danger of systemic inflammatory escalation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammatory Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how acute inflammatory responses are resolved, how damaged tissue is repaired, and how unresolved inflammation develops into chronic disease or granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on complement.
